Read ROADMAP.md and reorganize it for better clarity. Improve section hierarchy, add missing progress indicators, and ensure all phases 
  align with current CLAUDE.md status. Make the strategic vision clearer and more actionable. Commit with message 'docs: Restructure ROADMAP.md for improved 
  clarity'

Read all files in .claude-agents/config/ directory. Optimize agent template instructions for clearer behavioral conditioning, more 
  specific success criteria, and better task definitions. Ensure each template has specific, measurable goals. Commit with message 'docs: Enhance agent templates 
  for better performance'
